name: Calendar day agenda
summary: One day's schedule: a date header with previous, today and next, an all-day event, and timed events on an hour rail with overlaps side by side and a now line.
use: for one day's events in a scheduling or CRM tool
a11y: Events are links in a labelled list with the title, time and place in their text; the hour rail is hidden from screen readers and the now line has a text label.

use_when: a side panel that shows the rest of today next to other work, with what is happening now marked
avoid_when: a week or month at a glance: this day view does not stretch to it; build a week grid instead
a short list of upcoming items without times on a rail: use activity-feed

parts.name: day_num
parts.what: the day of the month in a tile; hidden in a narrow box

parts.name: date
parts.what: the weekday and date, the one heading

parts.name: summary
parts.what: how many events and how much time is booked

parts.name: nav
parts.what: previous day, Today and next day

parts.name: all_day
parts.what: the all-day event, a link with its title and a short note

parts.name: rail
parts.what: the hour labels down the left side

parts.name: events
parts.what: one timed event, a link with title, time, place and optional attendee photos; two overlapping events sit side by side

parts.name: attendees
parts.what: small photos and names of who is invited, inside an event

parts.name: now
parts.what: the line marking the current time, with its label

empty.how: the Smart UI renderer puts one plain 'Nothing to show yet.' line in an empty list

loading.how: the Smart UI renderer draws each marked slot as a quiet block of its size while the data arrives; the static file shows the filled part

error.how: if the day fails to load, keep the header and show an alert-banners line under it with a retry

disabled.how: set disabled on the previous and next buttons at the ends of the range the tool allows

overflow.how: in a narrow box the rail and padding shrink, and side-by-side events drop their place and use smaller titles

long_text.how: the event box is a fixed number of quarter-hour rows, so clamp each event title to one or two lines with an ellipsis

missing_image.how: a photo that fails to load shows the browser's broken image

keyboard: Tab reaches the previous day, Today and next day buttons, then the all-day event and each timed event in order
Enter on an event follows its link
Enter or Space presses a day button, but the file wires no action to them
